# Get Coverage by Grid from Orthos

## Pre-processing

For orthos that contain cutline polygons, crop to their associated cutline area and merge using "first". Also "clamp" the values from 0 to 1 for all bands to remove erroneous high or low values.

Next, I will manually georeference these images in QGIS based on the NLS ortho. Using the "linear" transform with nearest neighbour interpolation so that the pixel values aren't changed for the NDVI. If there are any "glint" areas, I'll remove these as well

```{r}
# Set bands 1-5 to NA wherever the alpha band (6) is 0, then drop alpha
maskAlpha <- function(r){
  alpha <- r[[6]]
  mask(r[[1:5]], alpha, maskvalues = 0)   # cells where alpha == 0 become NA
}

mergeOrthos <- function(lakeDir){
  imagesList = list.files(lakeDir, pattern=".*\\.tif$")
  
  outdir = file.path(lakeDir, "outputs")
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  outFile = file.path(outdir, paste("merged_clamped_", basename(lakeDir), ".tif", sep=""))
  
  # If there is more than one raster, merge
  if (length(imagesList) > 1){
    # load rasters
    raw <- c()
    for (f in imagesList){
      fpath = file.path(lakeDir, f)
      # if cutline geopackages exist, mask to that
      cutline = gsub("-orthophoto.tif", "-cutline.gpkg", fpath)
      
      s <- maskAlpha(rast(fpath))
      if (file.exists(cutline)) {
        cutline_poly <- vect(cutline, layer="cutline")
        s <- mask(s, cutline_poly)
      }
      raw <- c(raw, s)
    }
    out <- do.call(merge, (c(raw, resample=TRUE)))
  } else {
    # if there is just one raster, read it, masking alpha band
    out <- maskAlpha(rast(file.path(lakeDir, imagesList[1])))
  }
  # clamp values from 0 to 1
  out <- clamp(out, lower=0, upper=1, values=TRUE)
  writeRaster(out, outFile, overwrite=TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
# Remember to mount "new volume" first
orthos_path = "/media/northross/New Volume/Orthos"
lakeDirs.list = list.dirs(orthos_path, recursive=FALSE)[1:25]

for (lakeDir in lakeDirs.list) {
  mergeOrthos(lakeDir)
  tmpFiles(remove=TRUE)
}
```

### After georeferencing in QGIS, get the difference between new and old alignment

```{r}
compareGeoref <- function(orig_path, new_path) {
  a <- rast(orig_path)
  b <- rast(new_path)
  
  # Corners of each raster extent: xmin/xmax/ymin/ymax
  ea <- ext(a); eb <- ext(b)
  
  # Origin = upper-left corner (xmin, ymax)
  origin_dist <- sqrt((xmin(eb) - xmin(ea))^2 + (ymax(eb) - ymax(ea))^2)
  
  # All four corners, to catch changes from scaling
  corners <- function(e) cbind(
    x = c(xmin(e), xmax(e), xmax(e), xmin(e)),
    y = c(ymax(e), ymax(e), ymin(e), ymin(e))
  )
  ca <- corners(ea); cb <- corners(eb)
  corner_dists <- sqrt(rowSums((cb - ca)^2))
  names(corner_dists) <- c("UL", "UR", "LR", "LL")
  
  return(list(
    mean_corner_shift = mean(corner_dists),
    origin_shift = origin_dist,
    corner_shifts = corner_dists,
    res_original = res(a),
    res_new = res(b),
    dx = xmin(eb) - xmin(ea),
    dy = ymax(eb) - ymax(ea)
  ))
}

for (lakeDir in lakeDirs.list) {
  outdir = file.path(lakeDir, "outputs")
  mergedOrtho = file.path(outdir, paste("merged_clamped_", basename(lakeDir), ".tif", sep=""))
  georefOrtho = file.path(outdir, paste("merged_clamped_georef_", basename(lakeDir), ".tif", sep=""))
  if (file.exists(georefOrtho)){
    print(basename(lakeDir))
    print(compareGeoref(mergedOrtho, georefOrtho))
  }
}
```

## NDVI from Orthos

For each orthophoto, apply preprocessing, then get NDVI from standard formula.

Preprocessing:

1.  Mask glint areas based on the attached polygon, assign these to -1 on NDVI
2.  Mask shadows by filtering by low NIR values, assign these -1 on NDVI

```{r}
getNdviFromOrtho <- function(merged, shadow_threshold, glint_mask_path){
  # mask glint areas if they exist
  if(file.exists(glint_mask_path)){
    glint_mask <- vect(glint_mask_path)
    merged <- mask(merged, glint_mask, maskvalues=-1)
  }
  
  # mask shadows by minimum NIR value
  
  
  ndvi <- (merged[[4]] - merged[[1]]) / (merged[[4]] + merged[[1]])
  
  return(ndvi)
}

getWaviFromOrtho <- function(merged, L=0.5){
  wavi <- (1+L) * (merged[[4]] - merged[[3]]) / (merged[[4]] + merged[[3]] + L)
  return(wavi)
}
```

## Grid over lake

Generate a 10x10m grid covering the image area bounding box. Remove grid cells which don't overlap the lake area. Round the extent coordinates to multiples of 10 (Finnish CRS) so they all align with each other

TODO: restrict this to the image extent? For example for the very large lakes we just did a small area of

```{r}
getLakeGrid <- function(ndvi_bbox){
  # Get corner 
  corner <- st_bbox(ndvi_bbox)[c("xmin", "ymin")]
  # round to ten to align with other grids
  grid_corner <- round(corner/10, 0)*10
  
  lake_grid <- st_make_grid(ndvi_bbox, cellsize=10, offset=grid_corner)
  return (lake_grid)
}
```

## Fractional coverage

Using the following algorithm, get the fractional coverage over the grid.

$$c=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n f_i 
\begin{cases}
    1,  &0.6 \le x_i \\
    \frac{x_i}{(0.6-0.1)}, & 0.1 \le x_i  <  0.6 \\
    0, & x_i < 0.1
\end{cases}$$

```{r}
getFractionalCoverage <- function(ndvi, grid){
  # First apply the classification to the NDVI
  cutoffs <- c(0.1, 0.6)
  classifiedNDVI <- ifel(ndvi < cutoffs[1], 0,
                         ifel(ndvi < cutoffs[2], ndvi / (cutoffs[2] - cutoffs[1]), 1))
  print("classfied NDVI")
  # Now do zonal stats to get mean over the grid
  # TODO: Differentiate between 1 nodata pixel (ignore in mean)
  zonalOut <- zonal(classifiedNDVI, grid, fun="mean", na.rm=TRUE, as.polygons=TRUE)
  return(zonalOut)
}
```

## Execute functions over all ortho

```{r}
# Define helper function to fall back on the cache.export intermediates if exists and specified
cacheFallback = function(stepFunction, stepArgs, stepOutfile, useCache, exportIntermediates){
  if (useCache & file.exists(stepOutfile)) {
    # Read from output folder if exists and specified
    print(paste(stepOutfile, "already exists"))
    stepOutObject <- rast(stepOutfile)
  } else {
    # Else call the function to generate, and export if specified
    stepOutObject <- do.call(stepFunction, list(stepArgs))
    if (exportIntermediates) {
      print(paste("Exporting", stepOutfile))
      writeRaster(stepOutObject, stepOutfile, overwrite=TRUE)
      }
  }
  return(stepOutObject)
}

# Define function to export coverage from ortho
exportCoverageFromOrthos <- function(lakedir, useCache=TRUE, exportIntermediates=TRUE, skipCompleted=TRUE){
  outdir = file.path(lakeDir, "outputs")
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  outCoverageGpkg = paste("coverages_",Sys.Date(),".gpkg", sep="")
  outCoverageLayer = basename(lakeDir)
  # Try to check existing layers
  existing_layers <- tryCatch(
    st_layers(outCoverageGpkg)$name,
    error = function(e) list()  # Returns empty list if file doesn't exist yet
  )
  
  # Skip this layer if specified and the output already exists
  if (skipCompleted & outCoverageLayer %in% existing_layers){
    print(paste("Already completed", outCoverageLayer))
    return()
  } else {
    print(outCoverageLayer)
    
    # Generate NDVI
    ndvi <- cacheFallback(getNdviFromOrtho, c(merged, shadow_threshold, glint_mask_path), 
                          file.path(outdir, "ndvi.tif"),
                          useCache, exportIntermediates
    )
    print(paste("Got NDVI", outCoverageLayer))
    gc()
    
    # GENERATE WAVI
    wavi <- cacheFallback(getWaviFromOrtho, c(merged),
                          file.path(outdir, "wavi.tif"),
                          useCache, exportIntermediates
    )
    print(paste("Got WAVI", outCoverageLayer))
    gc()
    # Remove merged grid from memory
    rm(merged)

    # Generate grid
    ndvi_bbox <- st_as_sf(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(wavi)))
    grid <- getLakeGrid(ndvi_bbox)
    coverage <- getFractionalCoverage(wavi, vect(grid))
    print("Got WAVI coverage grid")

    # Write coverage grid to gpkg
    writeVector(
      coverage,
      filename=outCoverageGpkg,
      layer=outCoverageLayer,
      insert=TRUE,
      overwrite=TRUE
    )
    gc()
    return()
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Remember to mount "new volume" first
orthos_path = "/media/northross/New Volume/Orthos"
lakeDirs.list = list.dirs(orthos_path, recursive=FALSE)[1:25]

# Set to TRUE to used cached images if they exist
useCache = TRUE
# Set to true to skip a file if its final output already exists
skipCompleted = FALSE
# And whether to export intermediate files
exportIntermediates = TRUE

for (lakeDir in lakeDirs.list) {
  exportCoverageFromOrthos(lakeDir, useCache, exportIntermediates, skipCompleted)
  tmpFiles(remove=TRUE)
}
```
